i18n.enTitle: What is AI HR? Tasks that can be delegated in recruitment, evaluation, and labor, and points to note when introducing them
i18n.enSummary: AI human resources is an initiative that incorporates AI into human resources operations such as recruitment, evaluation, and labor affairs, and by entrusting document creation and data analysis to personnel, it creates a state in which personnel can concentrate on decisions that only humans can make. There are many people in charge who are unable to decide on the first step because they feel, ``Management has told me to use AI in human resources, but I'm worried that it will cause problems if I use it for recruitment or evaluation.'' AI can safely reduce man-hours by starting with tasks where humans can pick up mistakes, and by making sure that humans are responsible for determining treatment.
